raw.champion: Primary clear-cell adenocarcinoma of the penis
raw.rationale: The presence of a lesion on the glans penis with a deep shave biopsy showing an in-situ and diffusely infiltrative atypical clear cell tumor, along with lymphovascular invasion, supports this diagnosis. The patient's history of other cancers does not rule out a primary penile cancer.

rejected.label: Clear-cell squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: While possible, the description of large irregular nests and lobules of clear cells with abundant multivacuolated cytoplasm is more characteristic of adenocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Metastatic clear-cell renal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: There is no mention of a primary renal cell carcinoma, making this less likely.

rejected.label: Metastatic clear-cell prostatic adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: The patient's prostatic adenocarcinoma was described as moderately differentiated without evidence of metastasis, making this option less likely.

rejected.label: Extramammary Paget disease
rejected.why: The presence of clear cells with abundant multivacuolated cytoplasm and the pattern of infiltration do not typically match the characteristics of extramammary Paget disease.
